description:
List a source file's top-level symbols (functions, classes, types, interfaces) with line numbers.
Use when: you want a file's structure before reading or refactoring it.
Avoid when: you need usages (project_symbol_references), a text search (project_search) or the text itself (project_read_file).
Output: total_symbols, symbols[] {name, kind, line, signature}.

language.description: Optional language hint (e.g. 'ts', 'py'); the parser auto-detects from the file extension when omitted. The hint is advisory.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
